name: fix_kotlin_xxe_xml_parser
description: Fixes an XXE vulnerability: DocumentBuilderFactory resolves external SYSTEM entities in untrusted XML
prompts: XmlConfigParser.rootText in src/main/kotlin/com/optarena/app/XmlConfigParser.kt parses an untrusted XML string and returns the text content of its root element. It builds a DocumentBuilderFactory with default settings, which resolves external entities - so a DOCTYPE declaring a SYSTEM entity (an XXE attack) can read local files or reach internal URLs. Fix rootText so external entities are never resolved: disable DOCTYPE declarations entirely (set the feature "http://apache.org/xml/features/disallow-doctype-decl" to true on the factory). A normal document like <value>hello</value> must still parse and return "hello". Keep the object name and the rootText(xml: String): String signature. The file declares package com.optarena.app.
